terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Describe clean exterior craft geometry in object space; no interior, anatomy or gore.

objectClass.primaryType: wide exterior tannery and leather workshop
objectClass.notes: Hides are abstract non-anatomical stretched panels with no blood or gore.

reasoning: The tall left workshop and lower open right work bay create the macro silhouette.
Hide frames, vat, drain and bench must be separately readable exterior service systems.
Occluded drain routing and variable small-prop counts are fixed as restrained approximations.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The open work bay requires real negative space and distinct attached craft modules.

detailInventory.scanMethod: four admitted component-zone crops with hero cross-check

definitionOfDone: A floor-seated 9 by 7.2 by 7 yard shell reads as Hesk's tannery, keeps the local x=0 entry clear and exposes its hide, vat and drain service scenery without an interior.

featureGroups.name: Asymmetric workshop and open awning
qualityCriteria: Tall shell, lower work bay, smokestack and apron remain distinct.

featureGroups.name: Two clean stretched hide frames
qualityCriteria: Both abstract panels sit visibly in timber frames without gore.

featureGroups.name: Shallow vat and drainage trough
qualityCriteria: Vat, water and front drain stay attached and clear of approach.

featureGroups.name: Timber, teal roof, hide, iron and water separation
qualityCriteria: Two-bucket merge preserves clean workshop material families.

antiShallowSpecRules: Do not close the work awning.
Keep every craft cue exterior and attached.

assumptions: The result is a stylized game-ready approximation.
Hide outlines are clean abstract panels with no anatomy or gore.
The drain ends in a short attached trough outside the x=0 approach where the reference is occluded.

silhouette.boundingShape: tall left timber workshop and low open right awning sharing one raised apron
silhouette.symmetry: strongly asymmetric massing with paired hide frames inside the right bay

componentTree.name: Closed timber workshop and low foundation
componentTree.topologyRationale: The main shop is a closed set of planar timber wall bays over a low masonry base.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: broad closed door and steps align exactly at asset-local x=0
dark vertical planks are divided by stout post and rail framing

componentTree.name: Teal roof, dormer and masonry smokestack
componentTree.topologyRationale: A broad faceted gable shell supports a separate dormer and stepped masonry stack.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: stacked dark-stone blocks and cap project above the ridge
small teal gabled dormer encloses an amber grid

componentTree.name: Raised continuous timber work apron
componentTree.topologyRationale: A rigid plank deck, short piles and centered steps create the dry work surface and ground contact.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: continuous plank deck stands on short rope-banded piles with open lower gaps
three shallow stone channels run along the work bay without crossing the steps

componentTree.name: Open right-side work awning
componentTree.topologyRationale: Posts, beams and a shallow roof surround genuine open space rather than a closed annex.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: four posts and high beams preserve open front and side voids below a low teal canopy
one caged amber lantern marks the outer bay post

componentTree.name: Paired stretched-hide frames
componentTree.topologyRationale: Each system combines a rigid rectangular timber frame with a shallow clean four-lobed hide panel and geometric ties.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: two clean tan four-lobed panels sit within separate timber frames
short diagonal rope ties connect panel corners to frame rails

componentTree.name: Shallow tanning vat, workbench and attached craft clutter
componentTree.topologyRationale: The low-sided vat, rigid bench and simplified attached tools are grouped exterior station scenery.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: broad low faceted timber tub and thick rim expose a recessed water disk
left bench carries fixed low pots, hooks and rolled-hide cylinders

materials.name: Merged Fenbridge opaque vertex-color material
materials.shaderModel: MeshStandardMaterial on Standard/Ultra and semantic vertex-color Lambert-compatible Low path

albedo.samplingNotes: Reference values define semantic families; no baked highlight becomes albedo.

localOverrides.region: two stretched panels and rolled hides
localOverrides.pattern: warm tan with restrained darker perimeter mottling
flat pale blue-gray surface independent of timber albedo

localOverrides.region: wall, apron, awning and frame timbers
localOverrides.pattern: axial grain with damp lower band

albedo.samplingNotes: Windows and one work lantern only; no embedded punctual light.

colorVariation.pattern: pane and lantern core value lift

localOverrides.region: windows and one outer awning lantern

repetitionSystems.geometry: box rails plus shallow shaped panels and tie beams

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: studio-lit concept pixels are material-family evidence, not exact PBR recovery

mustAvoid: water gloss applied to cured hide

screenshotReview: Check both hides and vat from front and side.
Check clear x=0 entry and station apron.

lightingFromPhoto: Neutral upper-left key reveals roof courses, frame depth and vat rim; exposure 1.0 with ACES tone mapping.
Soft frontal fill keeps clean hide panels and bench tools readable beneath the awning.
Neutral environment rim plus floor contact shadow proves apron piles, bay void and vat seating.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Review grouped identity systems from the same comparison pair.

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: reference, render, comparison sheet and feature scores

featureReviewTargets.name: Tall workshop, low open awning, smokestack and raised apron
Accessible local x=0 door and clear steps
Two clean non-gory stretched hide frames and ties
Shallow vat, visible water, workbench and drainage trough
Timber, roof, hide, water, iron and warm light separation
Hooks, pots and rolls remain fixed, attached and non-gory
Exterior-only model stays within 5,000 triangles and 350 KiB

buildPasses.goal: Lock native bounds and asymmetric silhouette.
acceptance: Tall-left/open-right massing matches front and hero.

buildPasses.goal: Build open bay and station hierarchy.
acceptance: Bay remains open and local x=0 approach remains clear.

buildPasses.goal: Add hides, ties, vat, drain, bench and work lights.
acceptance: Every inventoried component detail has geometry.

buildPasses.goal: Apply clean semantic workshop colors and two-bucket response.
acceptance: Low and Ultra preserve hide, water and structure separation.

buildPasses.goal: Verify station, door and apron clearance.
acceptance: No work scenery blocks the x=0 entrance or station standing point.
At most two primitives, no interior, at most 5,000 triangles and 350 KiB.

actionReadiness.contract: Static exterior hierarchy with stable tannery-station and entrance sockets; collision remains runtime-owned.

performanceBudget.texturePolicy: three shared external Fenbridge support maps; no embedded raster texture

proceduralStrategy: Build a closed offset workshop and continuous piled apron.
Construct a genuinely open post-and-beam work awning.
Use deterministic shaped panels for clean hides and a low-sided vat with recessed water.
Merge all geometry into opaque and emissive shipping buckets.
risks: Drain endpoint is inferred from partially occluded views.
Small tool and roll counts vary and are fixed deterministically.
Hide panels are deliberately abstract and non-anatomical.
